description: This file contains functions for resolving and formatting provider authentication overviews, including handling API keys, tokens, OAuth profiles, and environment variables, for use in an authentication management system.

methods.name: formatMarkerOrSecret
methods.description: Formats an API key or marker string, masking or marking it accordingly.

methods.name: formatProfileSecretLabel
methods.description: Generates a display label for a profile's secret, handling references and secret types.

methods.name: resolveProviderAuthOverview
methods.description: Main function that compiles an overview of provider authentication profiles, environment keys, and model keys.
